chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: lone slightly detuned pulse-wave lead with a faltering melody that trails off into rests
cold thin string pad like mist
low slow synth bass holding long roots
faint irregular water drips instead of a beat
drained misty marsh where the lights went out, hollow, grieving and uneasy but never violent
seamless transition back to the theme
